summary: Space Memory is an interactive digital museum that tells the stories of forgotten NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars. Our project aims to make these forgotten objects remembered and help people understand their importance in space exploration. Through our website, users can explore space stories, discover equipment, view images, and enjoy interactive quizzes. We use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS to create an engaging learning experience. Our goal is to make space history simple, fun, and accessible to everyone.
details:
Space Memory is an interactive website that presents forgotten NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars.

Our project helps people understand the history of space exploration and discover the important role of these forgotten machines.

The website allows users to explore space stories, discover old equipment, view images, and test their knowledge through interactive quizzes.

We developed the website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with Tailwind CSS to improve the design.

Our idea is creative because it turns forgotten space equipment into an interactive digital museum. It makes learning about space easier, more interesting, and accessible to students and everyone interested in space exploration.

Our future goal is to add more information, 3D models, and new space discoveries.
